description: Defines classes and structures for starting a MAC-FAPI cell procedure, including configuration, dependencies, and the main procedure class with transaction handling methods.

classes.name: mac_fapi_start_cell_procedure
classes.description: Handles the process of starting L1 processing in a MAC-FAPI context, including message exchanges and transaction management.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the procedure asynchronously within a coroutine context.
